note_text: Equivalent to CTRL-AIR-01 used on the previous platform. Same 24V DC supply and CAN interface. Approved for standard and comfort configurations.

author: S. Martin
note_text: Référence saisie avec un O au lieu du zéro dans certaines extractions PLM. Se reporter à CTRL-AIR-01.

author: A. Johansson
note_text: Nordic temperature sensor is required below -20°C. Minimum operating temperature is -40°C.

author: A. Johansson
note_text: Same mounting interface and controller as the baseline HVAC module. Fan and temperature sensor are upgraded for low temperature operation.

author: J. Leroy
note_text: Export door controller is a functional counterpart to DCTRL-001 but uses 48V DC auxiliary power. Do not merge the two material identities.

author: S. Martin
note_text: Version renforcée du contrôleur de porte, utilisée lorsque le cycle de porte est plus élevé. Même interface CAN que la version standard.

author: P. Dubois
note_text: Same display family as PAX-DISP-15 and PIS-DISPLAY-15. The PLM references differ by project, not by physical display specification.

author: P. Dubois
note_text: High-capacity train uses the same passenger information architecture as the standard variant. Mechanical mounting was not changed.

author: A. Johansson
note_text: Rugged display is required for the Nordic configuration due to the colder operating environment. It should not be treated as the same component as the standard display.

author: C. Moreau
note_text: Le contrôleur PIS est commun aux configurations Standard, Comfort et Nordic.

author: J. Leroy
note_text: Baseline auxiliary converter. 750V DC input, 24V DC output. Used on all non-export configurations.

author: A. Johansson
note_text: Nordic version keeps the same electrical architecture but is qualified to -40°C. Same input/output voltage as baseline.

author: J. Leroy
note_text: Export converter belongs to the 48V auxiliary electrical architecture. It is not an identity match with APC-750-24 even though the function is similar.

author: C. Moreau
note_text: Unité de surveillance batterie utilisée sur les variantes 24V.

author: J. Leroy
note_text: 48V export battery monitoring unit. Functional equivalent of the 24V unit, but different electrical interface.

author: P. Dubois
note_text: Cab controller is reused across standard, comfort and high-capacity variants.

author: A. Johansson
note_text: Nordic cab controller is based on the same architecture as the baseline unit and adds low-temperature qualification to -40°C.

author: C. Moreau
note_text: Camera family is shared across variants. Rugged camera is preferred when the environmental qualification requires it.

author: A. Johansson
note_text: Rugged camera has the same communication protocol and optical function as the standard camera. Housing and temperature qualification differ.

author: S. Martin
note_text: Le processeur de comptage voyageurs est identique sur les variantes Standard, Comfort et Export.

author: C. Moreau
note_text: High-capacity train uses additional counting cameras but the processor and software architecture remain common.

author: A. Johansson
note_text: Nordic LED driver is the cold-rated version of the baseline driver. Same DALI interface and 24V supply.

author: J. Leroy
note_text: Some legacy PLM exports refer to this material as LDR-037. Both references should resolve to the same material.
